Question Choices: Compute 25×7×4 using a convenient multiplication rule.
Hints: Use the commutative rule to multiply 25 and 4 first;Then multiply by 7
Solution: By the commutative rule, $25\cdot7\cdot4=(25\cdot4)\cdot7$.;Since $25\cdot4=100$, the product is $100\cdot7=700$.
